title: SHWFS-AO accepted cross-backend physical comparison baseline
description: Canonical shape of the accepted AO-REF-018 cross-backend baseline artifact. This is the version-1 runtime contract enforced by shwfs_ao.validation.regression and emitted by scripts/generate_cross_backend_candidate.py; the packaged reference_metrics/cross_backend/cross_backend_baseline.json instance validates against this schema byte-for-byte.

allOf.$comment: A clean tree has no divergence from the recorded commit, so it cannot also carry patch evidence of one.
A dirty tree must record the content hash of exactly what diverged from the recorded commit.
